capLoss.method: E[(X − cap)+] / bet: the exact and B0 parts of the split + P(T) × E[(X − cap)+ | T] by importance sampling (2,000,000 triggering boards with the hold_and_spin_lock_respin value draws from (1 − 0.1)·p + 0.1·(size-biased p), weighted by the likelihood ratio (7,424 at the cap; mean weight 0.9995))

stats.label: RTP
stats.method: uncapped 96.0037% (mc ± 0.0656%) = base 96.004% + feature 0.000% − cap 0.0001%. Base: trigger-conditional split: E[B0] 54.5087% exact (the spec without the modifier mechanic) + P(T)·E[X − B0 | T] 41.4950% ± 0.0656% (P(T) exact, n 2,000,000 triggering boards); Cap loss: E[(X − cap)+] / bet: the exact and B0 parts of the split + P(T) × E[(X − cap)+ | T] by importance sampling (2,000,000 triggering boards with the hold_and_spin_lock_respin value draws from (1 − 0.1)·p + 0.1·(size-biased p), weighted by the likelihood ratio (7,424 at the cap; mean weight 0.9995)).

stats.label: Hit rate
stats.method: P(B > 0) + Σ_k P(B = 0, K = k)·(1 − P(F = 0 | k)) over the base distribution, P(F = 0) from the feature DP; the base law is the trigger-conditional split (exact outside the trigger, paired conditional sample inside)

stats.label: Win > stake rate
stats.method: P(X > stake): exact over the base distribution: every round that can reach the stake does so on the base spin (F ≥ 0)

stats.label: Volatility (SD per round, stakes)
stats.method: UNCAPPED: √(E[X²] − E[X]²), E[X²] = E[B²] + 2Σ_k E[B·1{K=k}]·E[F|k] + Σ_k P(K=k)·E[F²|k] (B ⟂ F given K), exact moments from the feature DP; the cap only lowers it

stats.label: Feature frequency (Honey Harvest)
stats.method: 1 / P(T), P(T) = P(≥ 6 of symbols [11] on the initial board): exact count convolution over the reel windows

stats.label: Feature share of RTP (Honey Harvest)
stats.method: P(T)·E[X − B0 | T] / rtpUncapped: X the spin's coins, B0 the same initial board's pay without hold_and_spin_lock_respin (trigger-conditional Monte Carlo)

stats.label: Average feature win (Honey Harvest)
stats.method: E[X − B0 | the feature ran] / bet

stats.label: P(win ≥ 100×) per round
stats.method: P(X ≥ 100·stake): exact over the base distribution: every round that can reach 100× does so on the base spin (F ≥ 0)

stats.label: Max win (declared cap)
stats.method: slot.config.json maxWinStakes; a round that reaches it ends and pays it

stats.label: P(reaching the max win) per round
stats.method: the split: P(B0 ≥ cap) parts (exact + paired sample) + P(T) (exact) × P(X ≥ cap | T); P(T) exact × P(X ≥ cap | T) by importance sampling: 2,000,000 triggering boards with the hold_and_spin_lock_respin value draws from (1 − 0.1)·p + 0.1·(size-biased p), weighted by the likelihood ratio (7,424 at the cap; mean weight 0.9995)

stats.label: Dry streak p95 (longest miss run in 100)
stats.method: exact DP over the current miss run, rounds iid with P(miss) = 1 − hit rate = 0.639057; p95 = smallest L with P(longest ≤ L) ≥ 0.95; at hit rate ± 3 SE it is 14–14

stats.label: Session (median balance after 200 rounds from 100)
stats.method: 20,000 sessions of 200 rounds at 1 stake from 100 stakes, rounds sampled from the split (clamped) base distributions, capped per round; a player whose balance is below 1 stake stops (bust); median with a distribution-free order-statistic 95% CI
